JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM) Petitioner/accused No.2 has filed the caption petition under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking grant of anticipatory bail in Crime No.11/2025 for the offence punishable under Section 21(1)(2)(3) of Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 and under Sections 406 and 420 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

sentences.text:
The informant, one Ravi, lodged a first information report before the CEN Crime Police Station,
Raichur, alleging that the present petitioner/accused No.2 NC: 2025:KHC-K:6634 HC-KAR had introduced him to accused Nos.1 and 3 to 6, who were stated to be engaged in online trading activities.
It is alleged that the said accused persons assured the complainant of a monthly return of 10% as interest/dividend on the investment made by him.
Though such returns were paid for the initial period of six months, thereafter, the accused failed to pay the agreed amount, thereby leading the complainant to lodge the present complaint.

3. The only specific allegation attributed to the petitioner/accused No.2 is that he introduced the complainant to accused Nos.1 and 3 to 6, who are alleged to have been operating the online trading business.
The complaint further discloses that the petitioner is also one of the members associated with the said trading concern.

However, as the complaint itself indicates that the investment was Sri Abhishek @ Abhinesh Kumar vs The State Of Karnataka on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12860823/
2 made through account payee cheque in favour of accused No.1, and that the agreed returns were duly paid to the complainant for a period of six months, NC: 2025:KHC-K:6634 HC-KAR the burden lies upon the prosecution to establish the culpability of the petitioner for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 21(1), (2), and (3) of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act,
2019 and Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

4. Accordingly, for the foregoing reasons, the following order is passed:
ORDER

The respondent-Police are directed to release the petitioner on bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.11/2025 of CEN Crime Police Station, Raichur, for the offences punishable under Sections 21(1), NC: 2025:KHC-K:6634 HC-KAR (2), and (3) of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 and Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, subject to the following conditions:
i) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within fifteen (15) days from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the like sum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
ii) The petitioner shall cooperate with the investigation and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
iii) The petitioner shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses or evidence, either directly or indirectly.
